title: Treasury budget body
description: The Treasury's budget for one institution (or for its own allowance line) for one month (credits.md 5.2 T10 and T5, treasury.md, register row DK7). Signed by the Treasury; one budget per institution per month; the first budget of an institution, and any later one that raises it by more than a quarter, also carries the owner's co-signature. The sum of open budgets never exceeds the Treasury's balance. Treasury payments to an institution, and allowances to newcomers, are capped by it. Chain: none (prev is null). Credits are accounting entries, not money.

institution.description: The institution account the budget funds; the Treasury's own account for the newcomer allowance line (purpose allowance).

purpose.description: The charter line the budget funds, or allowance.
